opening.argument: The video promotes MoonBag staking with an asserted 88% annual percentage yield for the first six months and tells viewers to imagine $1,000 reaching $1,880 in a year. It then urges immediate participation in the presale: “Don't miss these lucrative ventures — dive into the Moonbag Presale today and explore the possibilities.” Viewers are directed to moonbag.org to get started, while referral bonuses and influencer earnings encourage purchases through referral codes. Together, the exceptional return claims, direct purchase prompts, and referral incentives show an active investment solicitation, not neutral analysis. The evidence establishes the promotion of a staking and presale opportunity; it does not establish that anyone incurred a loss or received the projected return.
